meta.title: Event reasoning — TitleDetailsView (archive instance)
meta.description:
## Event → field reasoning — TitleDetailsView (2nd instance, feeds Archive screen only)

- **BookTitleAdded** → sets titleId, title (initial value)
- **BookTitleDetailsUpdated** → overrides title with the latest edited value

This instance exists because BookTitleDetailsUpdated's column sits after the earlier TitleDetailsView instance (which feeds AddCopy/Edit-Details) — a later event can never connect backward into an earlier read model that already feeds a screen, so a fresh, later-positioned instance was created per the framework's 'new copy' pattern instead.
